refundConsent.title: Updated terms
refundConsent.disclosure: We have updated our terms to cover Apple refund reviews. By agreeing below, you accept the updated terms and allow Shelvr, through RevenueCat, to share purchase and delivery information with Apple when you request a refund. Apple makes the final decision. Your saves and the places in them are not part of this.

refundConsent.syncPending: Your choice is saved. Updating RevenueCat; the previous setting may apply until this finishes.
